look change: draw-nolayout plus no width transition on the host, so the headline text jumps to the new width at the start of the draw-in instead of gliding over 0.9 s; the width is set once (wkLayoutFrames_values: 1 layout frame per cycle, faithful 2 per frame), the other draw frames need no layout in WebKit or Chromium (full_inRest_nolayout): look-change, for the user's visual review
